_note: B-69. Restore lever on the mock tenant state. Mock only; no backup product is called. Restores go to an alternate location only: there is no in-place overwrite lever, and an alternate location name must start with ALT-.

levers.name: restore.to-alternate
levers.description: Ask for one backed-up file, mailbox item or VM of the client to be restored to an ALTERNATE location. Never the original location. Mock of a backup product's restore-to-alternate call; records a request in the client's own state.

item_id.description: The backed-up item to restore (file, mailbox item or VM), e.g. RI-1001

alternate_location.description: Name of the alternate restore location, always starting with ALT-, e.g. ALT-RESTORE-1001. The original location is not accepted.

impact.L1: A person gets a deleted or damaged file, mail item or machine back as a copy beside the original; a restore for the wrong person would hand over someone else's data.
impact.L2: The client gets its data back without risking the live copy; a restore that overwrote the original could destroy newer work or hide the cause of the loss.
impact.L3: A restore is a registered, approved change with the requester verified first and an audit record; the original is never replaced by this lever.
impact.L4: Restores are the moment backups prove their worth; one careful path at every client keeps data back with its owner and nobody else.
